entities.name: token 定价 (token pricing)
entities.how_described: 本集反复讨论:按 token 向客户收费会被精明的客户看穿是「给 Claude token 加价 4 倍转卖」,等于和模型厂商正面竞争;Vanta 的做法是自己吞下 token 成本、接受更低利润率,先把使用量和体验做上去。

evidence.quote: This is a good business and you have to keep doing things that make business sense and doing the things that customers want, which may or may not be token pricing models that put you more in the latter category than the former profile.
